title: cyathea dregei var. segregata
intro: Cyathea dregei var. segregata, commonly known as the South African fern, is a species of fern in the family Cyatheaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its medicinal properties, which have been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of this plant include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Cyathea dregei var. segregata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
